name: Thomas Waitz - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on North Macedonia
part_text:
The European Parliament says North Macedonia should keep moving towards joining the European Union. It asks the country to change its constitution as promised, and asks EU governments to promise clearly that the next step in the talks will follow without new conditions once that is done. It also calls for stronger action against corruption, better courts, freer media, and cleaner energy, and it criticises the country's recent abstention on a United Nations vote about Ukraine.

- The report is an opinion; it does not change any law itself.
- It affects North Macedonia's government, parties and citizens, plus EU governments.
- Next, EU governments decide on the next step of the membership talks.
